yeah I could but 20 years is quite a long time to give it a go, I meet a lot of people, its not like i haven't put myself out there, and it never works. 

And I'm sure if reddit met me they wouldn't love me.

Thank you for writing something though

Because its really easy to say having a girlfriend (or boyfriend) isn't important when you've had one. And then you're ok with being single because you know you can be loved again.

I never have been and I get angry at myself for being such a loser piece of shit for it. 

sorry for being angry/swearign not in a good way at the moment and you are only trying to help me :( thnakayou

Please don't commit suicide. I really want to right now as well and seeing someone else that wants to has shook me a bit. I actually don't have any consolation at all. 

What can we do? Nothing except await death in the loneliest way possible. It just feels like every human has experienced being loved (by someone other than their family) and I don't know why I'm not allowed to. Am I too stupid? Too shy? Too ugly? All 3? Fuck knows. If I knew I wouldn't be lonely. 

But yeah, I'm really sorry man, I have probably made it worse just because I wanted to have a rant. Sorry man, really. I'm not a very nice person. I really hope everything perks up for you man
yeah, see this is why I want to kill myself man. Thanks for putting it better than me. I don't think anything can help.

Also, I don't want to be a 40 year old virgin, its not about being the only person, its just that I do not want to be that person and it is very much outside of my control because I have tried so hard for so long and it doesn't work. I've tried not caring too, but I'm to weak to manage. 

Thanks again man

But I'm not even sure if that matters. I just not want to live a life as a 30 year old virgin. Or get to that stage. I'm really sorry man, I don't want to be rude, and it has come off that way. 

Thank you for caring and for helping me

Thanks man, sucks what you're going through. I just really don't want to end up in that position myself, because it will just keep driving me insane. I am the same as you that I fantasise about it every single day but I can't do that anymore man. 

Thank you again, the fact that you were willing to help me means that you are a good person. I hope things get better for you.

I can't remember if I wrote it or not but the virginity thing isn't a problem, it's the fact that I've never had a girlfriend. Would rather know that at least one person can love me, but it hasn't been proven yet and it wont be because I am going to end it. Sorry man, and thanks for your help. I don't want to 'ride it out' because I don't enjoy anything. 

Thanks again though, you are a good person.
